_comment: The community video catalog behind /community/videos.
Every field except `group`, `slug`, `step`, `poster` and `title` comes from
Vimeo's own oEmbed record for the video and was read from it on 2026-09-04:
https://vimeo.com/api/oembed.json?url=https%3A//vimeo.com/<video_id>
`duration` is in seconds; `width` and `height` are the video's true pixel
size and set each card's aspect ratio, which is why the portrait pollination
clips are no longer letterboxed into a landscape box the way the legacy page
did.
`title` is the Vimeo title normalized to the house sentence case (Carson,
2026-09-04) -- capitalization only, never rewording, and proper nouns keep
their capitals. Vimeo's own title is one oEmbed call away if it is ever
needed. `description` is Vimeo's, unchanged.
`poster` names a file in images/videos/. Those are Vimeo's own thumbnails,
downloaded and served from here so that no third party is contacted until a
reader presses play.
To add a video: fetch the oEmbed record, save the thumbnail into
images/videos/, and add an entry here. Nothing else needs editing.
The pollination clips are ordered by the procedure they document, following
the numbered steps on /controlled_pollination rather than the order the
legacy page happened to list them in.
